svg.title: Replication and sharding solve different problems
svg.desc: Comparison of replication and sharding. Replication keeps identical copies of the whole dataset on a primary and its replicas, scaling reads and surviving node failure at the cost of replication lag. Sharding splits different rows across independent shards by a partition key, scaling writes and storage but breaking joins and cross-shard transactions.
